English: Wooden Idol Post
A simple wooden post inscribed with sacred runes, serving as the first focus of local worship, marking the grove as holy ground.
Stone Idol
A weathered stone figure replaces the wooden post, lending the site greater permanence and attracting more followers to the grove.
Idol Grove
The grove is cleared and organized, with paths and standing stones surrounding the idol, and gatherings for worship become regular.
Decorated Idol Grove
The grove is adorned with carved totems, ritual banners, and sacred objects. Pilgrims journey here, drawn by tales of the spirit-haunted grove.
Enclosed Idol Sanctuary
A wooden palisade or low stone wall now encloses the sacred grove, offering protection and a sense of sanctity to the faithful.
Ornate Idol Sanctuary
A grand sanctuary of stone and wood now stands, richly carved and painted. Rituals, festivals, and the teaching of mysteries are held here.
Idol Grove Hall
A great hall for feasts and councils is raised beside the sanctuary, drawing learned priests and wise men to instruct the faithful and preserve ancient lore.
Grand Idol Grove
The sacred grove is now a renowned pilgrimage site, with processional ways, shrines, and a great circle of oaks. Its spiritual power is widely famed.
Blessed Idol Grove
Priests and petitioners gather beneath the ancient trees, and the site is believed to be directly blessed by the gods. Great rituals are held year-round.
Sanctified Idol Grove
The grove is made wholly sacred, with relics, holy springs, and the presence of a high priesthood. Its influence radiates across the land.
